title: Windmill
place: Persia (Khorasan: eastern Iran and western Afghanistan)
summary: Horizontal (panemone) windmills appeared in Persia, first to pump water and then to grind grain.
why: A new source of power alongside water and muscle.

notes.problem: Source says Persian windmills were first built to pump water; the 9th-century report is from Khorasan.
